---
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: true
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in 'S1 First supplement' 'Figure S1: A first supplementary square.' '(S1)' 'Theorem S1 (A first supplementary theorem)' 'Figure 2.1: A second square.' 'Theorem 2.1 (A body theorem)' 'S2 Second supplement' 'Figure S2: A second supplementary square.' '(S2)' 'Theorem S2 (A second supplementary theorem)' 'See S1, S2, Figure S2 and Theorem S2.'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
          pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -qE '^.?2\. Second chapter$' || { echo "the second chapter is not numbered 2"; exit 1; }
---

# Preface {.unnumbered}

The preface.
